fields.title: Fiji TenderLink tender/award record
fields.description: One record per row. Shape is identical for recordType CURRENT_TENDER (listType=current) and TENDER_AWARD (listType=awards) except awardedTo, which is only ever populated for awards. A single _error record is emitted instead of payload fields when a request fails or is unreachable.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: Which list this record came from: 'list:current' or 'list:awards'.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record, or 'none' on error.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on a failed run (blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

referenceNumber.title: Reference number
referenceNumber.description: TenderLink's own notice code for this tender.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What is being procured, usually including the RFT number and sometimes the procuring entity's name.

awardedTo.title: Awarded to
awardedTo.description: TENDER_AWARD only -- the winning company's name, parsed out of the upstream Summary text where published (not every awarded tender has this published).

dateTime.title: Date/time
dateTime.description: Upstream free-text close date/time (CURRENT_TENDER) or closed date/time (TENDER_AWARD), in Fiji local time (FJT).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both record types -- rows missing a given column render blank.
